cases.text: What time is it right now?
Turn on the kitchen lights please.
Set a timer for twelve minutes and thirty seconds.
What is the temperature outside today?
Remind me to call Kevin tomorrow at nine forty five.
Play some jazz music in the living room.
The wifi password is on the router card in the hallway.
Add eggs milk bread and two hundred grams of coffee to the shopping list.
Is the garage door closed and the front door locked?
Tell me a short story about a lighthouse keeper in Costa Rica.
Lower the thermostat to sixty eight degrees at ten pm.
How many unread messages do I have from yesterday?
Cancel the seven thirty alarm but keep the eight o'clock one.
What's the fastest route to the airport avoiding highways?
Switch the bedroom speaker to the news briefing.
Thanks for everything, talk to you later tonight.
